extraction.summary_en: This filing records the minutes of an ordinary general meeting of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES dated 24 June 2024, approving the 2023 accounts, allocating the profit to reserves, deciding not to appoint a statutory auditor, and granting powers for formalities. It contains no capital increase/decrease, share transfer, or shareholder entry/exit; the only capital figure (400,000 euros) appears solely in the letterhead and per instructions is not treated as a snapshot.

evidence.quote_fr: TEXTE DES RESOLUTIONS AUX DECISIONS DE L'ASSEMBLEE GENERALE EN DATE DU 24 juin 2024

issues: The document only shows the letterhead capital figure (400,000 euros); no article 'Capital social' or répartition table is printed, so no snapshot was recorded per instructions.
